title: Query specific DNS record types
summary: Use `dig` to look up specific types of DNS records like MX (mail servers), TXT (verification), or CNAME (aliases) for a domain.

steps.explain: Query the DNS for a specific record type. Replace <RECORD_TYPE> with the type you need (e.g., MX, TXT, CNAME, NS).

placeholders.name: DOMAIN
placeholders.description: The domain name to look up

placeholders.name: RECORD_TYPE
placeholders.description: The DNS record type to query (A, MX, TXT, CNAME, NS)

steps.expect: The values for the requested record type.

alternatives.explain: Query the default DNS server for a specific record type (e.g., CNAME, TXT) of the domain.

placeholders.name: FIELD
placeholders.description: The DNS record type to look up (e.g., CNAME, TXT, SOA)
